description: Dual-Blinded Independent Human Adjudication Protocol for Establishing Ground Truth in Safety Backfire Research.

reviewer_1.qualification: Certified Industrial Safety Professional (CSP / PE) with warehouse mobile equipment expertise.
reviewer_1.blinding: Strictly blinded to Reviewer 2, AI candidate scores, Model H outputs, and detector bounding boxes.

reviewer_2.qualification: Independent Human Factors & Ergonomics Safety Engineer.
reviewer_2.blinding: Strictly blinded to Reviewer 1, AI candidate scores, Model H outputs, and detector bounding boxes.

lead_adjudicator.role: Adjudicates discrepancies when Reviewer 1 and Reviewer 2 reach conflicting gate-level or final determinations.

event_presentation_interface.visual_display: Synchronized multi-pane video player rendering Camera A (primary), Camera B (entry), Camera C (depth), and Camera D (cross-view) in synchronized 60Hz lockstep.
event_presentation_interface.telemetry_display: Time-aligned telemetry ribbon displaying speed, longitudinal acceleration, brake pressure, and steering angle synchronously with the video playhead.
event_presentation_interface.controls: Frame-by-frame bidirectional stepping, loop playback of PRE/INTERVENTION/POST intervals, and zone polygon overlay toggle.
event_presentation_interface.epistemic_sanitization: All model scores, detector bounding boxes, and heuristic labels are completely stripped from the review interface.

proposed_gt_taxonomy.label: CONFIRMED_BACKFIRE
proposed_gt_taxonomy.definition: An active intervention in response to a primary hazard causally precipitated an unconfounded secondary hazard exposure in an observable secondary zone.
proposed_gt_taxonomy.prerequisites: Intervention confirmed + Complete secondary observability + Net secondary risk increase + Causal linkage validated + Confounders excluded.

proposed_gt_taxonomy.label: NO_BACKFIRE_OBSERVED
proposed_gt_taxonomy.definition: The intervention averted or mitigated the primary hazard without generating or transferring hazard into any observable secondary space.
proposed_gt_taxonomy.prerequisites: Intervention confirmed + Secondary zone observable + Zero secondary hazard increase (or secondary zone verified clear).

proposed_gt_taxonomy.label: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
proposed_gt_taxonomy.definition: Available sensor data, lines-of-sight, or temporal windows are inadequate to definitively confirm or refute the presence of safety backfire.
proposed_gt_taxonomy.prerequisites: Secondary depth occluded OR unconfirmed confounder OR missing critical telemetry.

statistical_metrics.scope: Pairwise final event classification between Reviewer 1 and Reviewer 2
Gate-by-gate consensus across G1 (Intervention), G2 (Observability), G3 (Risk Delta), G4 (Causality)

discrepancy_resolution_workflow: Step 1: If Reviewer 1 and Reviewer 2 agree on final taxonomy label, consensus label is automatically accepted.
Step 2: If disagreement occurs on any gate, the event is routed to the Lead Adjudicator.
Step 3: Lead Adjudicator reviews the synchronized event package and writes an explicit adjudication rationale.
Step 4: The original individual review forms and the final adjudication note are permanently committed to an append-only audit log.
